newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat sees 250 bln lire gain in Prime sale.
newsitem.headline: Fiat sees 250 bln lire gain in Prime sale.

text.p: Italy's Fiat group said it expects to realise a 250 billion lire pre-tax capital gain from the sale of fund manager Prime and a stake in life insurer Prime Augusta Vita to insurance group Generali.

Under the operation announced last week, Generali will acquire outright control of Prime following a deal to acquire the Fiat group's 95.1 percent stake in Prime, one of Italy's biggest fund managers.
Generali will also acquire an 18 percent stake in life insurance venture Prime Augusta Vita from Fiat, raising Generali's shareholding in Prime Augusta to 40 percent.
Fiat and Generali said last week the value of the deal was 325 billion lire.
Fiat said in a statement on Monday the 250 billion lire capital gain derived 190 billion from Prime and 60 billion from Prime Augusta Vita.
